title: Create content
description:
Take a photo of something in the neighbourhood, and post it on social media.
The photo must get at least 10 likes (or equivalent) within 10 minutes.
rule1: You may not like the photo, request likes, or tell anyone you need likes to win
rule2: You may attempt this challenge only once per neighbourhood

title: Know someone who lives around here
description:
Visit a house or building where someone you personally know currently lives, or used to live. 
Tell your team about it.

title: Cat!
description: Photograph an actual real life cat.

title: Write an ode to the other team
description: Send a complementary poem to the other team.
rule1: The poem must be positive about the other team
rule2: The poem must include a rhyme for each of the other team’s names
rule3: The poem must be at least 8 lines long

title: Stalk a bird
description: Film a bird for 2 minutes.
rule1: The bird must be distinct and visible in frame for the entire video
rule2: The video must be continuous e.g. no pausing

title: Attend a local event
description: Attend a local event.
rule1: The event must have at least 10 people in attendance
rule2: The event must have some kind of public advertisement (facebook event, web page, poster)
rule3: You must attend for at least 10 minutes

title: Run for local election
description:
Make three promises about how you will improve this neighbourhood.
Make each promise outside of a school, library, church or park.
rule2: You may not use the same type of location more than once

title: Play a musical instrument
description: Play a real musical instrument.
rule1: The instrument cannot be improvised, or something you brought with you
rule2: The instrument must be something created for the purpose of making music

title: Touch Grass
description: Sit on grass for five minutes.
rule1: The grass must be alive and in the ground

title: Have fun
description:
Have fun for 15 minutes.
You must be doing a fun activity for the entire 15 minutes.
rule1: Your fun activity must involve something found in the neighbourhood
rule2: You must stay in the same place while having fun

title: Find something from your tattoo
description:
Find something that a team member has a tattoo of.
If nobody on your team has a tattoo, go to a tattoo parlour, and find something from the front window.
rule1: The thing must be physical, e.g. not a concept or feeling.
rule2: The thing you find must be as specific as the tattoo. A tattoo of a fireman cannot be a tattoo of a "person

title: Visit an interesting thing
description:
Choose a thing and visit that thing.
When you arrive at that thing, search for it on Youtube. If there is a video about the thing with at least 1000 views, you succeed. If not, you may try again with another thing.
rule1: The thing must be unique, not a category or type of thing
rule2: The video must mention or directly reference your thing in the title
rule3: The thing must be smaller than 100 x 100 meters

title: Photograph someone from far away
description: Photograph a team member from at least 500 metres away.
rule1: The other team member must be visible in the photo
rule2: You may seperate team members for this challenge

title: Visit every McDonalds
description: Visit every McDonalds in this neighbourhood.
rule1: There must be at least one McDonalds in the neighbourhood
rule2: You must go inside each McDonalds

title: Transport water between two fountains
description: Transport water from one fountain to another.
rule1: The fountain must not be intended for drinking
rule2: The fountain must be decorative and have flowing water

title: Create a sign haiku
description: Create a haiku out of signs.
rule1: The haiku must follow a 5-7-5 syllable format
rule2: Each line of the haiku must be one complete sign
rule3: The sign must be the name of a business, a street or landmark, or a public building

title: Power up
description: Find a real mushroom.
rule1: The mushroom must be naturally occurring, unharvested and obviously alive

title: Recreate a statue
description: Recreate a statue with your body.
rule1: You must be next to the statue you are recreating
rule2: The statue must include a depiction of a living creature

title: Confess your sins at three churches
description: Visit three different churches. At each church, a team member must confess a sin.
rule1: You do not need to enter the churches

title: Be grateful for a bench
description:
Find a public bench which names the person or people who donated it.
Enjoy the bench. Express gratitude to the donors.

title: Learn at a museum
description: Visit a free public museum. Learn something.
rule1: You must spend at least ten minutes learning things
rule2: The museum must describe itself as a museum.

title: Go somewhere nice
description:
Go somewhere you think has a google maps rating of 4.5 stars or more.
Check the score when you arrive. If the place has a rating less than 4.5 stars, you can attempt this challenge again after ten minutes.
rule1: You may not research before you go to the place

title: Go somewhere bad
description:
Go somewhere you think has a google maps rating of less than 3 stars.
Check the score when you arrive. If the place does not have a rating less than 3 stars, you can attempt this challenge again after ten minutes.
rule1: You may not research before you go to the place

title: Create a team uniform
description:
Create or acquire a uniform for your team.
All team members must wear the uniform until the end of the game.
rule1: All materials used in the uniform must cost less than $10 collectively
rule2: The uniform must be recognisable at a distance
rule3: The uniform must be the same for all team members
rule4: The uniform must not be made from things you already have with you.

title: Win a prize from a claw machine
description: You must win something from a real claw machine.

title: Steal their look
description: Try on 3 items worn by one mannequin. Take a photo posing next to the mannequin.
rule1: You may not take the items from the mannequin

title: Go one kilometre
description:
One team member must pick a random direction by spinning around with eyes closed.
Find the point exactly 1km in that direction using google maps.
Go to within 10 metres of that point.
rule1: If the point is legally or physically inaccessible, spin again
rule2: Claim the neighbourhood where you began the challenge, even if you leave it to complete the challenge.

title: Take a photo from up high
description: Take a photograph of your teammate from at least 3 stories above them.

title: Go to a place from a book
description:
Find a book that mentions a specific location.
Go to that place, and if possible, recreate the events in the book.
rule1: The location must be smaller than 100 square metres
rule2: Both the book and the location must be inside the neighbourhood

title: Shoplift
description:
Find something in a shop that weighs at least 50lb. You must verify with complete certainty that it weighs at least 50lb.
Lift that object off the ground.
